mutations.name: the default window is no longer one second
mutations.expectRed: 4 hits within the last second give 4

mutations.name: a hit exactly one window old still counts
mutations.expectRed: a hit exactly one window before now is out and a hit at now is in

mutations.name: perSecond stops dropping aged hits
mutations.expectRed: hits older than the window are dropped

mutations.name: a hit after now is counted
mutations.expectRed: a hit after now is not counted yet

mutations.name: an out of order hit is left unsorted
mutations.expectRed: an out of order hit that is already a full window old does not count

mutations.name: the count is not scaled to per second
mutations.expectRed: a 2 second window scales 4 hits to 2 per second

mutations.name: a non-positive window is accepted
mutations.expectRed: a window of 0 ms is refused

mutations.name: hit evicts by its own timestamp again
mutations.replace:
if (hits.length > MAX_HITS) hits.shift();
      while (hits.length > 0 && hits[0]! <= ts - windowMs) hits.shift();
mutations.expectRed: a hit dated after now does not evict an older hit still inside the window

mutations.name: the cap is removed
mutations.expectRed: the oldest hits past the cap are gone

mutations.name: the cap drops the newest hit
mutations.expectRed: the oldest hits past the cap are gone

mutations.name: the cap drops one hit too many
mutations.expectRed: the cap holds and the newest hits are the ones counted

mutations.name: a hit with a non-finite time is stored
mutations.expectRed: a hit with a non-finite time is ignored
